root_idea.summary: The root centers on giving and receiving an added gift or grant.
root_idea.development: From the idea of gratuitous giving, the evidence develops usages for spoils viewed as a bestowed grant, voluntary acts beyond obligation, additional gifts, and generous giving. Related derived usage also describes withdrawing from or selecting out of something.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the supported singular dictionary citation form نَفَل; the supplied Quran occurrences are its plural أَنْفَال.
Displayed as the established nominal citation form نَافِلَة.

senses.definition: Spoils or war gains regarded as a bestowed grant.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression أَنْفَال in 8:1, the term is reported with several scopes: the spoils themselves viewed as a divine grant, a portion received before division, gains obtained without fighting, or an item set aside after the division of the spoils. These are variant explanations of the Quranic spoils usage.

senses.definition: A supererogatory or voluntary prayer performed in addition to what is obligatory.
senses.usage_conditions: In 17:79, the word describes an additional prayer beyond the obligatory worship.

senses.definition: An additional bestowed boon; in the Quranic usage, a grandchild or descendant granted as an added gift.
senses.usage_conditions: In 21:72, نَافِلَةً is explained as a child of a child—a grandchild or further descendant—bestowed as an addition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To award someone spoils, or to bestow on someone a gratuitous or disinterested gift.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived transitive verb describing the conferral of spoils or an unsolicited gift; it may take both the recipient and the thing given as objects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant name, identified as Trifolium melilatus indica and Medicago intertexta.
An addition beyond the original; a voluntary gift, alms, or good deed beyond what is obligatory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: General Classical Arabic usage. The Quranic applications to supererogatory prayer and an added boon are represented separately under the Quranic form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A very generous man, characterized by abundant giving.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived nominal description of a person noted for generosity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withdraw or disassociate oneself from something; a related explanation gives the sense of selecting something out of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived usage reported with variant explanations; it is not a Quran-attested form in the supplied QAC data.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Awarding spoils or a gratuitous gift is represented.
Addition beyond the original is represented.
Voluntary gift, alms, good deed, and deed beyond obligation are represented.
Supererogatory prayer is represented under the Quranic form.

cautions: The scope of أَنْفَال in 8:1 is reported with several Classical interpretations; these are presented as variant scopes of the spoils sense rather than as separate Quranic forms.
